description: Cariboo Consolidated Roads is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Land Use Planning and Cumulative Effects - Cariboo. This dataset contains roads in the Cariboo Natural Resource Region that have undergone an ortho-verification process. This process entailed a manual review of every road segment against high resolution satellite imagery to determine a) if the road exists or not and b) if the road linework is in the correct location. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Land Use Planning and Cumulative Effects - Cariboo. Its tags are 100 Mile Natural Resource District, Cariboo Chilcotin Natural Resource District, Cariboo Natural Resource Region, Quesnel Natural Resource District, roads. It offers 1 resource(s) in FGDB. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
